fields.name: BoneTransforms
fields.evidence: Not replicated. Toolkit GameEngine.dll: constructor (+0x9F0440) zeroes +0 and +8 and calls UpdateBoneTransforms with the template's ObjectSet<ls::Transform> (+8 of ConstructionTileTemplate); move operator= (+0x15ADA0) frees the buffer at +0 and copies pointer(+0), u32(+8), u32(+0xC); GetBoneCount returns the u32 at +0xC (Toolkit accessor 'BoneCount'). GetRotationAtIndex/GetTranslationAtIndex/GetScaleAtIndex read quat at element+0, vec3 at +0x10, vec3 at +0x1C - Script Extender's Transform (40 bytes, CoreLib/Base/BaseTypes.h). The game type is ls::ObjectSet<ls::Transform> with the 16-byte {buffer, capacity, size} layout, identical to Script Extender's Array<T> (Script Extender's own ObjectSet has an extra member, so Array is used).
